name: ats-jobs-mcp
description: Open jobs from any company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board, plus keyword search across 16,000+ companies.
long_description: Look up a company's open jobs from its public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board (free, no key, official public APIs only). Optional: keyword search across a directory of 16,000+ company career boards via the hosted ATS Jobs Feed actor on Apify (needs an Apify token; about $1 per 1,000 jobs, billed by Apify).

tools.name: list_company_jobs
tools.description: List a company's open jobs from its public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board.

tools.name: detect_ats
tools.description: Find which ATS hosts a company's job board.

tools.name: search_jobs_all_companies
tools.description: Keyword search across 16,000+ company career boards (needs an Apify token).

apify_token.title: Apify API token (optional)
apify_token.description: Only for search_jobs_all_companies. Free account: console.apify.com/settings/integrations. About $1 per 1,000 jobs, billed by Apify.
